Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
What a crappy deck!

Ok, let's see.

Crypt [16 vampires] Capacity min: 9 max: 11 average: 10.125
7x  Malgorzata  (9)      priscus Tremere antitribu (group 4)
5x  Mistress Fanchon  (11)       inner circle Tremere (group 4)
4x  Sha-Ennu  (11)       regent Tzimisce (group 4)

I'll skip the crypt part because I don't want to do maths to know how many vampires you can expect to draw in a game to feed Malgorzata.

Library [90 cards]

Action [5]
5x  Govern the Unaligned

I'm not sure what they are there for. I'll assume it's more for ousting than Governing down. Anyway, Sha-Ennu can't play it. Either switch to Changeling (VIC, +1 bleed or +1 stealth) or Conditioning to keep the ousting power high.

Action Modifier [23]
6x  Elder Impersonation
4x  Forgotten Labyrinth
4x  Lost in Crowds
9x  Mirror Walk

What are the Forgotten Labyrinth here for? Using Malgorzata's special? Anyway, I would change Forgotten + Lost in Crowds to Into thin Air. You won't be doing lots of actions so card flow isn't very important here, and it works on bleeds. I fear you do have to much stealth anyway. Changeling could replace some cards.

Combat [13]
3x  Body Arsenal
3x  Flames of the Netherworld
7x  Wind Dance

Body Arsenal and Wind Dance are never used, and for a good reason: they are crap. Change them to some Chiropteran Marauder (maneuver or agg damage) for versatility. Maybe some Rego Motus could be fun too.

Master [38]
4x  Effective Management
10x  Golconda: Inner Peace
4x  Information Highway
3x  Obfuscate
3x  Parthenon, The
10x  Villein
4x  Zillah's Valley

10 Golconda? Man, are you really expecting to need them so early and in such quantity? 5 should be enough. 10 Villein is a lot too. The obfuscate skill cards are quite unnecessary, if you plan to Golconda your vampires at some point. Add Pentex. Add some Suddens, because if your prey starts to Villein his own vampires, you'll never oust him.

Reaction [11]
4x  Deflection
4x  Eyes of Argus
3x  Telepathic Misdirection

Conclusion: please add some ousting power and play a decent combat part. Play more versatile cards. Play some votes too, Reins of Power can do a lot of damage.

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Body:
> mirddes wrote:
> wind dance is a life saver against multiple strikes of agg

It must be your playgroup, because I've never seen aggravated additional strike decks. Play some Rego Motus if you're really afraid, but I think you'll be the scary guy at the table with VIC.

> mirddes wrote:
> but yes, original idea consisted of a _much_ (35) larger crypt, idea is to gain 20+ pool every few turns.
>
> any ideas on how to speed it up?
>
You can't. If you plan to gain lots of pool by influencing vampires, villeining them and golconding them, you have an irreductible slowness due to the influence. Golconda will happen during the minion phase, meaning your vampire won't be there during your turn to act.

Question is: why do you *need* to gain 20+ pool every few turns? Wouldn't it be more simple to play more defensive cards such as Deflection?

Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body:
> mirddes wrote:
> perhaps i need less cards.
>
> could a 60 card variant of this concept have more potential?
>
A big fat yes. You're going to be playing something like 3 cards in an average turn.

Don't force the Obfuscate on Malgorzata. Changeling, Plasmic Form, Mirror Walk and Seduction should be more than enough. If it isn't, Monastery of Shadows and Creepshow Casino are still better than playing Obfuscate masters.

Cut the aggrapoke, it will clog your hand and never be more than a minor inconvenience to your opponents. Play Meld with the Land if you don't feel safe without combat cards.

Cut 3 Info Highways and add 3 Zillah's Valleys.

Add Reins of Power, Ancient Influence and Political Stranglehold.

Consider the Ashur Tablet angle, Tablets + a few Kines and Conditionings could be a strong ousting mechanism.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Some of your stealth cards could be Veil the Legions.
Maybe Breath of the Dragon is better than Flames of the Netherworld.
6 Deflections *and* 6 Telepathic Misdirections do sound a lot to me. You can at least drop 4.

Also, based on how you're going to play this deck, you won't need that many Eyes of Argus (as you'll be bringing out someone at the end of your turn - and they'll be untapped).

Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body:
As a general guideline, you really shouldn't have any, let's say, 7+ cap vampires in your crypt that can't play each and every one card in your library. It is especially silly having a main vamp (which appears 6 times in your crypt - a bit too much even for Malgorzata's special) that can't play 6 cards from your crypt.

You should really pick your off-clan discipline - either OBF or VIC, and then choose your crypt accordingly. Both of those disciplines, in addition to in-clan THA, offer ample opportunities for stealth.

Also, I don't know where do you stand with card availability, but you really should drop Amaranths in favour of more Breaths. Also, your crypt is huge, you should diversify a bit and put smaller vampires.
